a.title: Price the actual Gaussian reader and cut its coefficient bill by 35.6%
a.body:
The actual 112-port Gaussian reader reaches character rank **30**, so its sharp dirty-bank cost is **2 ceil(30/q)+2 cross-bank shears**. An explicit dyadic centre basis reduces the four-shear word from **31,608 to 20,352 coefficient ADDs** (35.6%), without a new odd denominator. This closes the actual-source rank and coefficient-cost gap left by [PR5640](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5640) and [PR5634](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5634). No new kappa is claimed.

The [proof and boundary](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/98c17101e47ad378702f8c3eb450a87b7ac7bdc2/research/actual-gaussian-reader-tariff/README.md), [basis witness](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/98c17101e47ad378702f8c3eb450a87b7ac7bdc2/research/actual-gaussian-reader-tariff/BASIS.json), [all-width storage tradeoff](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/98c17101e47ad378702f8c3eb450a87b7ac7bdc2/research/actual-gaussian-reader-tariff/RESULT.json), [exact verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/98c17101e47ad378702f8c3eb450a87b7ac7bdc2/research/actual-gaussian-reader-tariff/verify.py), [source manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/98c17101e47ad378702f8c3eb450a87b7ac7bdc2/research/actual-gaussian-reader-tariff/SOURCES.json) and [frozen context](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/98c17101e47ad378702f8c3eb450a87b7ac7bdc2/research/actual-gaussian-reader-tariff/SOURCE-CONTEXT.json) are pinned to contribution head `98c17101e47ad378702f8c3eb450a87b7ac7bdc2`. Canonical base and final refresh are `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`, priority revision 7, selected conditional kappa 0.00310045. Only this package is added. [Coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19186810).

All 512 source character inverses, reader identities and exact rational ranks pass; modular ranks give matching lower bounds. Character 92 has rank 30. The physical inverse Walsh kernel has 15,628 reader coefficients. Ten basis changes reduce this to 9,968, with 208 scatter coefficients. The common denominator is 960, with odd part 15. The complete search over all 870 ordered row pairs and every possible improving dyadic coefficient proves that no single further row ADD reduces the bill. This is a local basis optimum, not a global ordinary-cost optimum.

The package emits exact coefficient bills and coefficient-ADD prefix/suffix bounds for every borrowed dimension 1 through 30. One borrowed field uses 62 shears and 18,331 coefficient ADDs; thirty use four and 20,352. All translation shifts and rational coefficients remain charged. A separate literal 512-address dirty-input replay agrees with the original source factors. Three controls reject a corrupted actual inverse, a wrong restoration-gather sign and a missing final scatter. The all-input endpoint follows from the checked factor identities and the written word proof; the physical test uses one deterministic payload.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/actual-gaussian-reader-tariff
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/actual-gaussian-reader-tariff
```

Expected: `PASS_ACTUAL_GAUSSIAN_READER_TARIFF`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Normal and optimized registered checks, exact committed-byte checks, export validation and a Git-free optimized replay pass. Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. CI is pending at publication. Full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout; source hashes and committed bytes were checked.

The lower bound uses the translation-kernel cross-bank alphabet. Unrestricted address mixing has a different contract. A smaller borrowed bank does not remove the thirty-field bank used inside the section. Rational arithmetic interiors, physical routing/tape costs, native/outer admission and a complete supplier/caller remain open. No full historical suite, selected cold replay, proof assistant or independent human scientific review was run.

Credit David Ganz (@Dugongue) for PR5634 and its native/campaign lineage, PR5640 for the sharp tariff, and centre-code-services for the actual response and inverse certificate. Frozen notices retain reciprocal-native-responses, native-centre-capture, centre-metric-encoders, PR3133, PR3148, PR2588 and PR2226. New source binding, basis reduction, proof and checks: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Next questions are a broader physically priced basis and one complete native caller; this package reserves neither.

b.title: Reconstruct a G20 native SOURCE from five prior values; ordinary BIT 0.003484629984
b.body:
A five-value native history reconstructs the missing SOURCE77 function at FRAME509. It lets helper444 replace H3+H1 by H4 while preserving every independent target and reusing the old zero centre. This is a new source reconstruction, distinct from PR5639's helper465/467 snapshots and PR5629's four retirements.

The complete ordinary BIT saving is **0.003484629984**, versus the pinned PR5512 value **0.003483969976**. The signed moment improves by `18*(1+3^t-4^t)` for every `0<t<1`; the full caller has 56,979 paid requests, 11,238 productive targets and eleven owned banks. No original input is erased and all five gathers, dirty clear, injection, routes and finite fees are charged. The old zero-centre work is removed from the literal program.

This is an independently usable component improvement, not a new best whole multiplication kappa. PR5641's separate four-retirement component is already numerically stronger. Combining them belongs to the integration lane; no such composition is claimed here. The selected frontier is unchanged.

c.title: Complete G20 snapshot fusion at ordinary BIT saving 0.003487922466
c.body:
**Constructive conditional ordinary BIT saving: 0.003487922466**, an exact gain of 0.000001313377 over [PR #5641](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5641). This emits and fully prices Dugongue [PR #5639](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5639), while reusing the old zero centre to reduce the owned reserve from 17 to 16 banks. No complete kappa or selected-frontier update is claimed.

[Scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8b1995f167471e79f77351fcdc014db3b338f818/research/g20-snapshot-native/README.md), [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8b1995f167471e79f77351fcdc014db3b338f818/research/g20-snapshot-native/PROOF.md), [exact checks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8b1995f167471e79f77351fcdc014db3b338f818/research/g20-snapshot-native/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8b1995f167471e79f77351fcdc014db3b338f818/research/g20-snapshot-native/SOURCES.json), [registered replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8b1995f167471e79f77351fcdc014db3b338f818/research/g20-snapshot-native/VERIFY.json). Base: canonical main `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`, priority revision 7. Contribution head: `8b1995f167471e79f77351fcdc014db3b338f818`.

The snapshots preserve every retained arbitrary original and endpoint. All 546 obsolete whole-zero centre accesses are proved removable. The complete 18-call caller retains 11,166 originals, pays 56,817 queries, and allocates 16 owned banks with no output credit. Against PR5641 the paid change is `-36 H1-36 H3+36 H4`, with unchanged targets and strict gain `36*(1+3^t-4^t)>0` for `0<t<1`. [Discussion #5642](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5642) records the claim and scope split.

Normal and optimized registered replay pass. The native word tracks all 661 original/dirty entry columns; separate adjoint checks use other address points at moduli 101 and 10201. Separate stream replay checks 445,838 events, all 56,817 query descriptors, targets, owned returns and positive costs. Two census implementations check all 667 nested blocks on every retained field, with arbitrary prior same-frame binary combinations. A third eligible window at helper444 was [handed to its active investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5638#discussioncomment-19186960), with a direct SOURCE77 snapshot replacing five gathers. It is excluded from this emitted bill. Two rational engines certify raw crossing `(0.00348792248477,0.00348792248480)`, fresh finite thresholds, 16-bank stock and four acyclic ordinary levels. The admitted saving is less than `1.89e-11` below that crossing. Stale snapshot, missing teardown, stale epoch and unfunded price controls reject.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-snapshot-native
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Committed-byte checks pass. The native/all-width, ROW, compiler, precision, tape and analytic premises remain conditional. Full historical suites and formal-kernel proofs were not rerun; separate implementations are not independent scientific acceptance. The finite uniform program and astronomical decimal threshold are algorithm-defined, not materialized. Other producers, protected-read retiming and paid frame changes are outside the frozen census. This shallow checkout cannot run the full ancestry audit. A reproduced upstream Current CI missing-link regression currently blocks the generic hosted planner; the package has complete local replay evidence. Hosted status is unconfirmed at publication.
